title.ru: Кукольный домик из Alice Madness Returns
title.es: Casa de muñecas de Alice Madness Returns
title.pt: Casa de bonecas de Alice Madness Returns

generated.description: A large fantasy-style dollhouse inspired by Alice: Madness Returns, built mostly from stone with green and lime wool roofs, oak planks, stairs and fences, and glowstone lighting. It measures about 130 blocks wide, 72 high and 97 deep, and uses roughly 70,000 blocks. The interior includes bookshelves, chests and signs.
